title: 工人预科
concept: An empty 1930s workers' classroom. On a modest LOW TEACHER DESK, not a speech podium or political lectern, lies ONE OPEN NOTEBOOK and ONE small white chalk stick. Through a high classroom WINDOW in background one sees a coal-mine winding headframe silhouette, with ONE tiny warm incandescent bulb behind the window, the only warm element in the CENTRAL scene. Cool gray slate and aged off-white paper elsewhere. Notebook marks are abstract unreadable strokes. No people, microphones, portraits, flags.
